PROPOSED, not implemented. Depends on the final authentication mechanism confirmed under DEC-013; the request/response shapes below are candidates only and no token or session refresh is implemented.

AuthCredential.title: AuthCredential
AuthCredential.description:
提供者定义的不透明认证状态。

``scheme`` 与 ``value`` 的格式由身份服务决定；``expires_at`` 为 UTC 过期时间，
``None`` 表示提供者未声明过期（不代表永久有效）。

AuthUser.title: AuthUser
AuthUser.description: 经后端验证的身份信息。不含角色/租户字段（待 DEC-013）。

LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest
LoginRequest.description: 登录请求。密码用 SecretStr 承载，repr/日志不出现明文。

DevUserId.name: X-User-Id
DevUserId.description: MVP development/test identity only; production returns 503 until real auth is integrated.

AuthCredential.name: Authorization
AuthCredential.description: Opaque provider-defined credential in the form '<scheme> <value>' (v0.2; semantics decided by the identity service confirmed under DEC-013).
